restriction: For canonical clause (ii), retain only consistency under the following explicit C1 and C2 premises; equivalence with the unsupplied canonical P018-T10 hypotheses is not asserted. C2 assumes iid units, measurable uniformly bounded records with an intercept, at most two records per dyad, one common ordered-pair kernel used in original or reversed endpoint order with injective Boolean record orientations, deterministic weights with positive scales a_N and a uniform finite bound 0 < w_Ndt/a_N <= C, and H_(w/a),N tending to a positive definite limit. These are substantive model and limit premises, not usual measure-theoretic existence conditions. The finite covariance identities, UI-based actual-covariance implication, moment-failure examples and deterministic-limit equivalence are retained.
